# Murmur

> Murmur is a speech-to-text app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch that transcribes audio with OpenAI's Whisper model running on the user's own device. No account, no uploads, no analytics; works offline after a one-time model download.

Key facts:
- Engine: Whisper Large v3 Turbo (compressed, about 632 MB, recommended) or Small (about 500 MB), run on device through WhisperKit.
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, plus auto-detect. App interface in English.
- Devices: iPhone, iPad, Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 15+), Apple Watch (records and sends audio to iPhone).
- Summaries: Meeting, Lecture and Bullet point templates with action items, made on device with Apple Intelligence on supported devices.
- Export: plain text (speakers, timestamps, summary), Markdown, SRT subtitles, M4A audio.
- Privacy: App Store privacy label 'Data Not Collected'. Optional iCloud sync uses the user's private CloudKit database; audio is not synced.
- Pricing (USD): free download showing the first 2 minutes of each note; Pro $3.99/month, $19.99/year with 3-day free trial, $39.99 lifetime. Universal purchase.
- Speaker labels are added manually; Murmur does not detect speakers automatically. Murmur does not join online calls and does not translate.

## Features

- [On-device Whisper transcription for iPhone and Mac](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/on-device-transcription/): Murmur runs OpenAI's Whisper speech model on your own iPhone, iPad or Mac. Accurate transcripts with no uploads, no account and no server.
- [Offline transcription app that works in airplane mode](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/offline-transcription/): Transcribe audio with no internet. Murmur downloads its Whisper model once, then records, transcribes and summarizes offline on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- [Voice recorder with bookmarks and transcription](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/voice-recorder/): Record meetings, lectures and voice notes with one tap. Drop bookmarks while you record and get an on-device transcript when you stop. No account needed.
- [Transcribe audio and video files on iPhone and Mac](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/import-audio-video/): Import MP3, M4A, WAV and video files from Files, Photos or other apps and get private on-device transcripts. Batch queue, no upload, no account.
- [Private AI meeting summaries made on your device](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/ai-summaries/): Turn transcripts into meeting notes, lecture summaries and action items with Apple Intelligence, on the device. No cloud AI, no uploads.
- [Transcripts with speaker labels and talk time](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/speaker-labels/): Label speakers in your transcripts so you know who said what. Colour-coded names, talk-time bars on iPad and Mac, and labels in every export.
- [Transcript editor with tap-to-play audio](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/transcript-editor/): Tap any line of a transcript to play the audio from that moment. Edit text, split and merge lines, set speakers and undo changes, all on your device.
- [Search every transcript, with find and replace](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/search/): Find any word across all your recordings. Murmur searches transcripts and summaries, shows each hit with its timestamp, and replaces words across a transcript.
- [Custom vocabulary for accurate transcription](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/custom-dictionary/): Add names, product terms and jargon to Murmur's custom dictionary. They are passed to Whisper as vocabulary so transcripts spell them correctly.
- [Export transcripts as TXT, Markdown, SRT or audio](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/export/): Export Murmur transcripts as plain text with speakers and timestamps, Markdown, SRT subtitles, or M4A audio. Share to any app or copy to the clipboard.
- [Sync transcripts across iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/icloud-sync/): Optional iCloud sync keeps Murmur notes, transcripts, folders and dictionary in step across your Apple devices using your own private iCloud. Off by default.
- [Private transcription app: no account, no tracking](https://murmur.netofficials.com/features/private-by-design/): Murmur is a private transcription app with no accounts, no analytics, no ads and no servers. Recordings and transcripts stay on your device.

## Platforms

- [Murmur for iPhone: private speech to text app](https://murmur.netofficials.com/iphone/): Record and transcribe on iPhone with Whisper running on the device. Summaries, search, export and Apple Watch recordings. No account, works offline.
- [Murmur for iPad: transcription with summary side panel](https://murmur.netofficials.com/ipad/): Murmur on iPad: a three-column library, transcript beside summary and talk time, drag-and-drop import and a large recording view. On-device Whisper.
- [Murmur for Mac: offline Whisper transcription app](https://murmur.netofficials.com/mac/): Transcribe audio on your Mac with Whisper on Apple silicon. Menu bar recorder, global shortcut, batch queue, drag and drop, Markdown export. No uploads.
- [Murmur for Apple Watch: record voice notes from your wrist](https://murmur.netofficials.com/apple-watch/): Record voice notes and meetings on Apple Watch and get a private transcript on your iPhone. Complications, Action button support, works away from your phone.

## Use cases

- [Private meeting transcription with notes and action items](https://murmur.netofficials.com/use-cases/meeting-transcription/): Record in-person meetings and get a transcript, summary and action items on your device. No bot joins the call, nothing is uploaded.
- [Lecture transcription app for students](https://murmur.netofficials.com/use-cases/lecture-transcription/): Record lectures and get searchable transcripts and study summaries on your iPhone or Mac. Works offline in any lecture hall.
- [Interview transcription app for journalists and researchers](https://murmur.netofficials.com/use-cases/interview-transcription/): Transcribe interviews on your device with Whisper. Keep sources confidential, label speakers, search quotes with timestamps and export text.
- [Transcribe voice memos and voice notes on iPhone](https://murmur.netofficials.com/use-cases/voice-memo-transcription/): Turn voice memos and spoken notes into searchable text on your iPhone or Apple Watch. On-device Whisper, no account, nothing uploaded.
- [Make SRT subtitles from video on iPhone and Mac](https://murmur.netofficials.com/use-cases/video-subtitles/): Create SRT subtitle files from your videos on device. Import a video, let Whisper transcribe it, fix any lines and export SRT for YouTube or your editor.
